context: Two teens trade weekend stories at a bus stop
purpose: Teach: 美人/こども/さっぱり/またまた/そこそこ/あらためて/かたち/気配

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: またまた遅刻しそうだったよ、バス停に走ってきたら陸の気配がしてホッとした。
lines.en: I was nearly late again, but when I sprinted to the bus stop I sensed you were here and felt relieved.
lines.style: Bright teen girl, slightly breathless, casual warm tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おはよ。週末どうだった?こども食堂のボランティア行ったんでしょ?
lines.en: Morning. How was your weekend? You went to volunteer at the kids' cafeteria, right?
lines.style: Relaxed teen boy, friendly curious voice, casual register

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、行ってきた。年配のスタッフさんがそこそこ忙しそうで、私も配膳手伝った。
lines.en: Yeah, I went. The older staff seemed pretty busy, so I helped serve food too.
lines.style: Cheerful teen girl, recounting matter-of-factly, slightly proud

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: えらいなあ。俺は弟の発表会に行っただけ。ステージで踊ってる弟、なんか別人のかたちに見えた。
lines.en: That's admirable. I just went to my little brother's recital. Watching him dance on stage, he kinda looked like a different person.
lines.style: Laid-back teen boy, fond casual tone when mentioning brother

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 見たかった!陸の弟、美人のお母さんに似てるよね。
lines.en: I wanted to see that! Your little brother looks just like your beautiful mom, doesn't he?
lines.style: Teasing teen girl, playful warm laughter in voice

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: やめろよ。あ、そういえば数学の宿題、俺さっぱり分からなかった。教えてくれない?
lines.en: Cut it out. Oh, that reminds me, I didn't understand the math homework at all. Can you teach me?
lines.style: Embarrassed teen boy shifting topic, slightly whiny but friendly

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いいよ。バスの中であらためて見せて。難しい問題あったっけ?
lines.en: Sure. Show it to me again on the bus. Were there any tough problems?
lines.style: Helpful teen girl, gentle reassuring tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 全部。あ、バス来た。今日もそこそこ混んでるな。
lines.en: All of them. Oh, the bus is here. Looks pretty crowded again today.
lines.style: Resigned teen boy, light sigh, observational
